q: The online store is used for:
options: Fast access to the latest values during serving

q: The offline store is mainly used for:
Scores: 50 (Feb), 60 (Apr), 80 (Jul). What value is point-in-time correct for a label on 1 May?
explain: It is the last value known before 1 May.

q: Using a later value than the label date causes:
explain: The model would see information it can't have in production.

options: Takes the latest row at or before a given time

q: For one model with simple features, a good choice is:
options: A shared pipeline saved with the model
A full feature store with many teams
A separate feature rewrite in each language
explain: A store adds work that may not pay off yet.
It serves features for training and for live use.

q: A main benefit of a feature store is:
options: One definition of each feature, for training and serving
explain: It removes a major cause of skew.
